Sofia M: Hi team — quick one. Took a Grab from Changi to client site on 2026-03-18 morning for SGD 28.50 but driver lost the e-receipt and Grab app shows only a pending charge. Corporate card declined at the time so I paid on my personal card. I uploaded my card txn screenshot and put GPS screenshot of the trip. Can this be reimbursed? Also wondering whether this qualifies for per-diem or local transport category. Link: https://uploads.mock/receipts/1891012345.zip

Lina (Finance): Hi Sofia, reimburse yes if we have supporting proof. For taxis/rideshares we need either the merchant receipt or a screenshot from the app showing charge details + a card statement line. The GPS screenshot is helpful but we need the txn line (date, amount, merchant). Can you paste the bank txn description exactly as it appears?

Sofia M: Bank shows: "GRAB*GRABPAY 03/18 SGP 28.50". I attached screenshot of the statement and a photo of driver receipt they scribbled (blurry). I can also forward the Grab app support email thread — they said they'll look for the receipt but might take 48-72hrs.

expense-bot: :warning: Attachment missing: bank_statement.png. Please attach the full card statement screenshot (showing last 4 digits).

Sofia M: Attached bank_statement.png and a short note from driver.jpg. Forwarded Grab ticket #G-55412 — they confirmed the payment ID but no full VAT-style invoice.

Lina (Finance): OK. That's sufficient for reimbursement per policy as a "taxi - alternate proof" when corp receipt unavailable. We need manager approval for anything > SGD 25 that lacks a merchant invoice. @Raj please approve. We'll code to TRAVEL:LOCAL. Note: per-diem is for meals only, so not applicable here.

Raj (Manager): Approved. Thanks for including the Grab ticket. Approving reimbursement and confirming charge is business-related.

Tom (Card Ops): Quick note — if corp card was declined at terminal it might be because of MCC mapping or cross-border AVS check. DM me the last 4 and timestamp and I'll unblock for future APAC taxis. Also consider requesting a virtual card with daily limit for travel.

Lina (Finance): Processing reimbursement of SGD 28.50. In Ramp please split the amount if you want to allocate across projects, otherwise we'll book as single line TRAVEL:LOCAL -> SGD 28.50 -> Project:CLIENT-APAC. Sofia please confirm preferred payout: standard payroll vs. ACH. If ACH, include routing last 4 masked.

Sofia M: ACH preferred. Sending masked routing: ****6789 via DM. Thanks all!

expense-bot: :white_check_mark: Expense submitted to payroll queue. Status: pending manager approval (done) -> queued for next ACH run.

Lina (Finance): Marking closed once payment posts. If Grab provides an official receipt later, please upload to keep records (we can replace the alternate proof).
